title: cineraria integrifolia var. umbellata
intro: Cineraria integrifolia var. umbellata, commonly known as the Silver Ragwort, is a plant species in the daisy family, Asteraceae. The Silver Ragwort is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce stress and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of this plant include sedative and anti-spasmodic effects, which can help to calm the nervous system and relax muscles. The bioactive constituents of the Silver Ragwort include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and other compounds that have been shown to have antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties.
